prompt: Is it possible to make an HTML element undeletable from JavaScript? Regardless of the answer, is it possible to make an element unmodifiable from JavaScript?
response: You can make an HTML element undeletable from JavaScript by setting a custom attribute, like `data-undeletable="true"`, and then checking this attribute before attempting to delete the element. Similarly, to make an element unmodifiable, you can use the `readOnly` property for form elements or a custom attribute for other elements.
